about: CLR Music batches 1-6: every sound already ingested into the Clear Music library at clr.fm/music, with the source identifiers and checksums from the original batch packages. Use source_id (when present) or source_key (source_url + original filename), plus sha256 (packaged file bytes) and pcm_sha256 (canonical decoded audio content), to dedupe a new batch against everything already in the library.
